title: Atlas Scientific Study Contract v4
description: scientific-study-contract.v4: the v3 tabular contract (binary, multiclass and continuous regression; unchanged, validated by $defs/tabular_contract) plus univariate_forecasting (temporal source, development window, sealed final holdout, expanding-window backtest, frozen specification catalog, failure/eligibility semantics, pooled-metric practical-tie selection and a finalization policy; validated by $defs/forecasting_contract). A forecasting contract carries no features, split fractions, cross-validation, class, positive class or threshold. v1/v2/v3 contracts keep validating against their own schemas.

canonical_run.description: The study's structured canonical-run artifact from which expected evidence is derived by JSON pointer. It must also be listed in source_repository.pinned_files.

positive_class.description: A class label for binary problems; an explicit not-applicable record (never null, never an arbitrary class) for multiclass problems.

classification_concepts.description: Regression only: explicit record that classes, positive class, class order, decision threshold and argmax decision do not apply.

membership_gate.description: Protocol precondition, not a reproduced result: execution stops before any model is fitted when an observed membership digest differs.

threshold_policy.description: A binary threshold rule, or an explicit not-applicable record. Null or an artificial value is never allowed.

interpretive_evidence.description: Descriptive evidence reproduced for comparison only; it never controls selection.

group_overlap_diagnostic.description: Descriptive-only error split by whether each evaluated row's group key (declared columns) also occurs in the reference (fitting) partitions. It never feeds split, search, selection or fitting.

runtime_identity.description: Byte-level identity of runtime outputs (e.g. probability-matrix bytes). Compared and reported, but a difference distinguishes 'byte-identical runtime' from 'same scientific protocol' and never makes a reproduction divergent.

protocol_integrity.description: What the study itself records about the isolation of its evaluation partitions. Procedural isolation of the corrected canonical run is kept distinct from historical exposure.

protocol_parameter_sources.description: Declared protocol inputs re-checked against the study's pinned structured artifact by verify_against_study_checkout.
